create_go1_env: create a Go1Env instance with an xml path and config for a Unitree Go1 robot simulation
get_go1_assets: get the model assets dictionary for Go1 robot XML files from local and menagerie paths
get_go1_sensor_data: get sensor readings like upvector, gravity, linvel, angvel, accelerometer, gyro, and feet position from Go1Env
configure_go1_pd_gains: configure PD gains (Kp, Kd) and simulation timestep for a Go1 robot model
access_go1_model_properties: access Go1Env properties including xml_path, action_size, mj_model, and mjx_model
